notes.title: 20% off Obliteracers, new update inbound!
notes.notes:
Howdy folks! We've been slaving away at Varkian Empire HQ on our best PC patch yet that addresses a tonne of bugs, glitches and other ghosts in the machine that you guys have come across in your Twitch/YouTube streams. Keep the videos coming and we'll keep improving the experience for you! We'll roll out the update shortly once we've done some more testing to make sure it's solid as a rock, but in the meantime if you haven't got your copy yet, now is a great time as you'll [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368740/]save 20% off the regular price[/url].

Stay tuned for our update and give us a holler in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/368740]Community Hub[/url] if you've got feedback or suggestions. Happy Obliteracing!

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.3640: DirectInput, keyboard remapping + more
notes.notes:
Mega patch 3640 has arrived! New stuff includes support for DirectInput controllers, keyboard remapping, "friends only" online matches, HUD improvements for better gameplay feedback, and lots of new shortcuts! We've also fixed random slowdowns in online multiplayer, reduced slipperyness on some Transporter maps, prevented unfair deaths due to online lag, made many HUD/UX improvements, and improved game stability and performance across the board. For full release notes see here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/368740/discussions/0/412448158148429889/

notes.title: Obliteracers Update 1.0.0.3519
notes.notes: We've just released an update that fixes some issues people were seeing on launch day, including VOIP settings sometimes not working as expected and overall stability improvements. We're also monitoring the Community Hub for bug reports, so keep them coming in! - M

notes.title: Obliteracers release date confirmed: 23 February 2016
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368740]Obliteracers[/url] will be coming to Steam on 23 Februrary 2016! 

We've been playtesting the game like crazy over the last few weeks, and it's feeling very solid now. You've probably seen some [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=obliteracers]Lets Play preview videos[/url] showcasing the game, and we'll make sure there's plenty more of them leading up to the release too.

Feel free to ask questions in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/368740]Obliteracers Community Hub[/url] or in the [url=http://www.reddit.com/r/obliteracers]Obliteracers subreddit[/url].

Thanks for your patience and we look forward to seeing you in-game!

All the best,
Michael and the Obliteracers team
